runners.name: Pens Street
runners.comment: PENS STREET was bumped between horses and pinched back at the start, trailed in the five to three path into the turn, advanced while moving out to six path entering upper stretch then sustained steady progress to reel in the leader at the wire.

runners.name: Nilo's Rose
runners.comment: NILO'S ROSE dueled for the lead with an outer rival into the turn, then with an outer trio nearing the lane, dug in and held an advantage into the final sixteenth but got nailed by an outer bidder at the wire.

runners.name: Beach Dancer
runners.comment: BEACH DANCER dueled two wide, then between horses turning for home, flopped back to her left lead while vying into the final furlong, yielded late yet held show.

runners.name: Crushed Ice
runners.comment: CRUSHED ICE stalked the embattled leading pair from the three path, ranged up to bid four wide at the five sixteenths pole, vied through midstretch but flattened out between rivals late and missed show.

runners.name: Sunset Harbour
runners.comment: SUNSET HARBOUR pursued two wide early on, was hustled forward between rivals entering the turn, bid three wide and between horses at the five sixteetnhs pole, vied among foes into the lane but tired through the final furlong.

runners.name: Cora's Legacy
runners.comment: CORA'S LEGACY broke outwardly and bumped a foe at the start, raced off of the pace along the inside and made little impact.

runners.name: Acousticat
runners.comment: ACOUSTICAT bumped with an inner rival at the start, chased from the four path, floated to the six path entering the lane and tired.

runners.name: Song of Songs
runners.comment: SONG OF SONGS stalked behind the top pair and from the two path around the first turn, shifted outside of them and to the four path at the five furlong pole, ranged up to bid outside only HEARTBEAT while kept in the four path around the far turn, dueled into the lane, forged an advantage at the furlong grounds then held from an outer challenger late.

runners.name: Don't Be Salty
runners.comment: DON'T BE SALTY lacked speed in the three path, inched closer in the four path approaching the far turn, fanned to the five path into upper stretch, sustained a rally through the final furlong to offer a late bid but was denied.

runners.name: Heartbeat
runners.comment: HEARTBEAT pressed the leader from the three path, vied down the backstretch, led around the far turn as the eventual winner offered an outside challenge, dueled with that one into the lane and through upper stretch but got headed at the furlong grounds then gradually yielded.

runners.name: Beara Peninsula
runners.comment: BEARA PENINSULA tracked from the three path, then between horses approaching the far turn, moved to the inside at the five sixteenths pole but only managed to chase in upper stretch and lacked a bid.

runners.name: Freak City
runners.comment: FREAK CITY stuttered a step at the start, trailed in the two path, advanced between horses with five furlongs to go, chased around the far turn and failed to sustain a bid.

runners.name: Leafology
runners.comment: LEAFOLOGY broke a step slow at the start, race off of the pace along the inside, trailed around the far turn and made little impact.

runners.name: Fasta Lavista Baby
runners.comment: FASTA LAVISTA BABY set the pace along the inside, got headed by an outer pair entering the far turn and wilted thereafter.

runners.name: Huck's Agenda
runners.comment: HUCK'S AGENDA pursued from midpack four wide, brushed with an inner rival while pursuing in the six to five path into the lane, rallied to bid in the four path at the furlong grounds, dueled with an inner rival through the final sixteenth prevailed.

runners.name: Tetiaroa
runners.comment: TETIAROA tracked along the inside, tipped to the two to three path entering the lane, rallied to bid between horses while keeping an inner rival hemmed in at the furlong grounds, battled with an outer counterpart through the late stages but got outfinished.

runners.name: Just Do Believe
runners.comment: JUST DO BELIEVE sped clear early on, got collared by an outer pair while shifting to the two path in midstretch, got headed shortly after and moved inwardly at the sixteenth pole, yielded late yet lasted for show.

runners.name: Carol's Melody
runners.comment: CAROL'S MELODY brushed an outer rival at the start, steadied out of tight quarters between hroses at the five furlong pole, held up behind rivals in the two to three path at the five sixteenths pole, rallied in the two path in upper stretch, but steadied and altered inwardly when blocked behind the leaders at the furlong grounds, steadied when troubled again behind a rival passing the sixteenth pole, altered out then was denied show.

runners.name: Good Call
runners.comment: GOOD CALL stalked two wide and between horses, brushed with an outer rival after being floated to the four path entering the lane then faded between horses.

runners.name: Tempting Eve
runners.comment: TEMPTING EVE bumped with an inner rival at the start, stalked three wide, steadied when brushed and put to tight quarters between horses in the five path entering the lane and weakened.

runners.name: Mom's Cheesecake
runners.comment: MOM'S CHEESECAKE bumped with an outer rival at the start then steadied between horses shortly after, trailed along the inside and got outrun.

runners.name: Mined That Gold
runners.comment: MINED THAT GOLD bumped with an outer rival at the start, stalked the leader from the three path, pressed before forging an advantage in the two path at the three furlong pole, inched clear entering the lane then held sway from an outer pursuer.

runners.name: Goal to Go
runners.comment: GOAL TO GO dwelt at the start, raced well back in the three path around the firs turn, rallied in the four path around teh far turn to take aim on the clearing leader entering the lane, drifted out slightly at the three sixteenths pole, came back in while flopping to his left lead at the furlong grounds, changed back to his right lead while sustaining pursuit into the final sixteenth but was kept at bay.

runners.name: Mo Que
runners.comment: MO QUE bumped with an inner foe leaving the gate, laid off of the pace in the three path, swung to the five path entering the lane, ran on to duel for show with an inner rival through the final furlong and prevailed.

runners.name: Celtic Mo
runners.comment: CELTIC MO set the pace near the inside as the eventual winner pressed down the backstretch, got headed by that one at the three furlong pole, yielded entering the lane, yet kept on to duel for show with an outer rival through the final furlong but got outfinished.

runners.name: Chasing Em
runners.comment: CHASING EM leaned inwardly at the start, raced forwardly along the inside, chased two wide and between horses around the far turn, shifted out through the lane and lacked a bid.

runners.name: Shamrock Guard
runners.comment: SHAMROCK GUARD broke outwardly and bumped the outer stall door at the start, tracked from the four to three path, got outkicked by an outer rival entering the lane and yielded between horses.

runners.name: Very Royal
runners.comment: VERY ROYAL got floated in subtly by an outer rival at the start, raced at the rear along the inside and showed little.

runners.name: Justice
runners.comment: JUSTICE set the pace along the inside, vied with an outer trio into the turn, then with a quartet of outer rivals at the five sixteenths marker, shook clear leaving upper stretch then held from an outer challenger late.

runners.name: Rank
runners.comment: RANK checked when shying from an outer rival soon after the start, trailed early on, advanced in the three path and between horses at the five sixteenths pole, swung out to the six path entering upper stretch, sustained a rally to offer a late bid but was denied.

runners.name: Patriot Moon
runners.comment: PATRIOT MOON broke inwardly and bumped a foe at the start, stalked behind the leading quartet approaching the turn, shifted outside of them at the three furlong pole, ranged up to bid five deep turning for home, but brushed with an inner rival and chased the clearing leader leaving upper stretch, got outkicked for place shortly after then held show.

runners.name: Sparked
runners.comment: SPARKED was bumped and floated inwardly by an outer foe after breaking a beat slow, raced off of the pace along the inside, pursued in the four to five path into midstretch and failed to factor.

runners.name: Bluebeard
runners.comment: BLUEBEARD pressed three wide and between horses, vied among foes around the turn then yielded leaving upper stretch.

runners.name: Leading Off
runners.comment: LEADING OFF raced off of the pace in the four path, got floated out to the seven path into upper stretch and failed to menace.

runners.name: Eleos
runners.comment: ELEOS pressed four deep, vied around the turn, then between horses turning for home, brushed with an outer counterpart in upper stretch then gave way through the final furlong.

runners.name: Magic Moose
runners.comment: MAGIC MOOSE prompted two wide and between horses early on, vied among foes around the turn, yielded entering the lane and faded.

runners.name: Sunny Ray (IRE)
runners.comment: SUNNY RAY (IRE) prompted outside of foes early on, gained an advantage while tucking three wide into the turn, inched clear leaving upper stretch, got collared by an outer pair late yet narrowly lasted.

runners.name: Mackinac
runners.comment: MACKINAC bumped with rivals on both sides at the start before being jostled between rivals shortly after, laid off of the pace along the inside, swung seven wide and between horses entering the lane, surged with a strong kick to offer a late bid but just missed at the wire.

runners.name: Solemn Vow
runners.comment: SOLEMN VOW eased back from between horses with nine sixteenths to go, tracked along the inside, slipped inside of a troubled rival entering the turn, progressed turning for home, shifted out to the three to four path whlie progressing and taking aim outside of the clearing leader leaving upper stretch, rallied to bid between horses in the closing stages but got outkicked.

runners.name: Ratu Jawa
runners.comment: RATU JAWA was bumped between rivals and steadied back at the start, raced at the rear in the two to three path, fanned nine wide into midstretch and offered a good belated kick.

runners.name: Lady Revenge
runners.comment: LADY REVENGE bumped an outer rival at the start, vied two wide and between hroses early on, then only with outer foes around the turn, fought on inside of the eventual winner through midstretch but yielded late.

runners.name: Cotillard
runners.comment: COTILLARD bumped with an inner rival at the start before being jostled between rivals shortly after, laid of off the pace in the three path, fanned eight wide and between rivals into the final furlong and ran on willingly.

runners.name: Ms. Jay Dee Em
runners.comment: MS. JAY DEE EM raced close up three wide and between horses, bumped with an inner troubled foe and steadied entering the turn, chased in the five path and between rivals into the final furlong and stayed on mildly.

runners.name: Quick to Charm
runners.comment: QUICK TO CHARM broke a step slow, tracked from the four path, swung to the seven path entering the lane, chased six wide into the final furlong and flattened out.

runners.name: Aldene
runners.comment: ALDENE vied four to three wide and between hroses, then between just a pair around the turn, switched out to the four path to be outside of his counterparts entering upper stretch, but gave way.

runners.name: Twirling Claire
runners.comment: TWIRLING CLAIRE stalked five to three wide into the turn, shifted five wide entering the lane then yielded.

runners.name: Coco G
runners.comment: COCO G jostled with an inner rival early on, raced at the rear in the three path and never got involved.

runners.name: Ships Inn
runners.comment: SHIPS INN vied along the inside early on, but went wrong entering the turn, faltered in the two path around the bend before being taken wide and pulled up in upper stretch, then was transported off of the track in an equine ambulance.

runners.name: Our Standard
runners.comment: OUR STANDARD set a pressured pace in the two path, vied with an outer prompter around the far turn, shook free of that one in midstretch and drove clear.

runners.name: Bagg O Time
runners.comment: BAGG O TIME raced off of the pace in the four path, crept closer in the three path turning for home, shifted to the four to five path in upper stretch and ran on to reel in place at the wire.

runners.name: Dewy's Denali
runners.comment: DEWY'S DENALI pressed from the four path early on, vied outside of the eventual winner while kept in the three path around the far turn, sparred into the lane but failed to keep pace with his inner counterpart in midstretch, gave way and got nailed for place.

runners.name: Easy Dial
runners.comment: EASY DIAL brushed an outer rival while being subtly put to tight quarters by an inner foe early on, raced off of the pace in the three path and between horses, fanned to the five to six path in upper stretch and ran on mildly.

runners.name: Surfin' M
runners.comment: SURFIN' M hopped at the start, trailed along the inside early on, inched closer in the four path around the far turn, fanned out to the six to seven path in upper stretch then flattened out and gave way.

runners.name: Refined Design
runners.comment: REFINED DESIGN was brushed by an inner foe early on, race close up in the two path, stalked between rivals down the backstretch, then along the inside around the far turn before weakening.

runners.name: T V Channel
runners.comment: T V CHANNEL prompted the leader from the three path and between horses, weakened with seven sixteenths to go and faltered rounding the far turn.

runners.name: Swamp King
runners.comment: SWAMP KING stalked along the inside then faltered turning for home.

runners.name: Tiffany Twist
runners.comment: TIFFANY TWIST broke slow, trailed in the two path, swung out to the seven path while building momentum in upper stretch, rallied to bid at the furlong grounds and kicked away.

runners.name: Creative Quality
runners.comment: CREATIVE QUALITY stalked the embattled leading trio from the three to four path around the turn, fanned out to the six path entering upper stretch, rallied to bid along with an outer counterpart at the furlong grounds but got outkicked.

runners.name: Dozen Diamonds
runners.comment: DOZEN DIAMONDS vied two wide and between horses, got outkicked by an outer pair of bidders at the furlong grounds and yielded.

runners.name: Tennesseehoneybee
runners.comment: TENNESSEEHONEYBEE broke a step slow, vied for the lead with an outer pair, got bested by a wider pair of bidders in midstretch and faded.

runners.name: Liuzza
runners.comment: LIUZZA raced off of the pace in the two path and failed to menace.

runners.name: Run Camila Run
runners.comment: RUN CAMILA RUN prompted three deep, vied around the turn but leaned to the four path entering the lane and weakened.

runners.name: Spring Spinning
runners.comment: SPRING SPINNING chased along the inside then weakened while hanging on her left lead.

runners.name: Icona (IRE)
runners.comment: ICONA (IRE) rated at the rear in the three path, shifted out in upper stretch before swinging nine wide into the final furlong, kick in to surge alongside the leader in the final sixteenth and edged past late.

runners.name: Princess Attitude
runners.comment: PRINCESS ATTITUDE stalked from the three to four path into the backstretch, pressed the leading trio before bidding in the five path at the five sixteenths pole, gained an advantage and led in the six to seven path in upper stretch, held sway into the final sixteenth but got caught by an outer bidder late.

runners.name: Fiery Lucy (GB)
runners.comment: FIERY LUCY (GB) pursued from midpack in the four path, took aim while fanning out to the eight path entering upper stretch, rallied along with an outer rival to bid between horses in the final sixteenth but got outkicked.

runners.name: Sanctify
runners.comment: SANCTIFY tracked from midpack in the three path and between horses, encountered traffic while entering the lane in the four path, shifted out to the five to six path leaving upper stretch and ran on willingly.

runners.name: Lit Ship
runners.comment: LIT SHIP was bumped by an outer foe at the start, set the pace near the inside, vied with an outer pair down the backstretch, inside of a trio at the five sixteenths pole then faded after moving to the three path in upper stretch.

runners.name: Lady Iva
runners.comment: LADY IVA vied three wide, then between horses turning for home, moved out to the five path while headed in upper stretch, hung on her left lead until midstretch and faded.

runners.name: Devassa (BRZ)
runners.comment: DEVASSA (BRZ) bumped an inner foe at the start, eased back between horses early on, raced at the rear in the two path then shifted out in the final sixteenth and moved up.

runners.name: Next Up
runners.comment: NEXT UP transferred contact from an outer rival to an inner foe at the start, saved ground off of the pace, committed to a rail charge in upper stretch but lacked a rally.

runners.name: Faye's Gold
runners.comment: FAYE'S GOLD stalked along the inside, chased in the two path in upper stretch and gave way.

runners.name: J Z's Last Schance
runners.comment: J Z'S LAST SCHANCE raced close up two wide and between horses, pulled entering the backstretch to vie for the lead two wide and between rivals at the five furlong pole, sparred around teh far turn then weakened after leaning to the four path in upper stretch.

runners.name: Timbertop
runners.comment: TIMBERTOP pressed the leader from the three path, assumed command in hand with five sixteenths to go, kicked clear under a mild drive then was geared down late.

runners.name: Finally No Drama
runners.comment: FINALLY NO DRAMA tracked from midpack in the three path, shifted to the five path entering the lane, brushed with an inner rival in upper stretch then rallied to be second best.

runners.name: Bourbon Ice
runners.comment: BOURBON ICE broke outwardly, raced off of the pace in the six to four path into the turn, got outkicked and checked between rivals entering the lane in the six path yet ralllied to edge show in the closing stages.

runners.name: She's a Beauty
runners.comment: SHE'S A BEAUTY was bumped between horses at the start before steadying early on, raced off of the pace in the four to five path into the turn, fanned to the seven path while progressing entering the lane, ran on to gain show passing the sixteenth pole but got caught at the wire.

runners.name: Yousuredoshine
runners.comment: YOUSUREDOSHINE broke outwardly, raced forwardly along the inside, chased two wide and between rivals nearing the turn, forged place while moving out to the four path in upper stretch and yielded.

runners.name: Fumed
runners.comment: FUMED broke a step slow and steadied when an inner rival shifted across her path at the start, raced off of the pace along the inside, shifted to the five path entering the lane, brushed with an outer foe in upper stretch then stayed on mildly between rivals whlie hanging on her left lead.

runners.name: So Jelly
runners.comment: SO JELLY broke slowly, lagged behind the moved up.

runners.name: Debating
runners.comment: DEBATING broke slowly, raced forwardly along the inside, within striking range around the turn, chased in the two path into the lane and faded.

runners.name: Sweet Venture
runners.comment: SWEET VENTURE bumped with an outer rival at the start, stalked from the four path, brushed with an outer foe in upper stretch and weakened between horses.

runners.name: Andy's Call
runners.comment: ANDY'S CALL chased from midpack in the five path and between horses then faded in the four to three path around the turn.

runners.name: Selah Breeze
runners.comment: SELAH BREEZE bumped with an inner rival at the start, set the pace inside of the eventual winner into the turn, proved no match with five sixteenths to go and stopped.
